verdict.rationale: Inngest automations are ordinary TypeScript, Python, or Go functions synced from your own deployed app, so versioning and review happen implicitly through your normal code workflow. The versioning doc says changes deploy without explicit version markers, which handles in-flight runs across deploys. No first-party version history, review or approval flow, or rollback mechanism is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit function version history in the platform, documented rollback to a prior version, review/approval workflow for changes, independent hands-on corroboration.
